# SAP Weighs Cutting at Least 10,000 Positions in AI Restructuring

![The headquarters of SAP SE in Walldorf, Germany.](https://assets.bwbx.io/images/users/iqjWHBFdfxIU/i7w8ZEx7Ye3c/v0/-1x-1.webp)

The headquarters of SAP SE in Walldorf, Germany. Photographer: Kirill Kudryavtsev/AFP/Getty Images

By Christina Kyriasoglou

November 26, 2026 at 7:15 AM AKST

## Takeaways by Bloomberg AI

SAP SE is preparing a plan to eliminate at least 10,000 positions to transform its software business for the artificial intelligence era, according to people familiar with the matter. 

The restructuring would affect at least 9% of the global workforce, the people said, asking not to be identified because discussions are ongoing. The total number of job cuts hasn’t been finalized and might still change after labor negotiations, they added.
